original: うーん……
traducao: Hmmm...

original: どうしましたの、ティトレイ？\n随分悩んでいる様ですけれど
traducao: What's wrong, Tytree?\nYou look troubled.

original: ああ、実は次の料理当番\nおれに回ってくる事んなってさ
traducao: Ah, it's just that I'm on\ncooking duty next.

original: せっかくだし、張り切って\n何か旨いモンでも作ろうと思うんだけど\nいまいちアイデアがわかなくてな〜
traducao: I wanted to put in the effort and\nmake something really tasty, but...\nI'm drawing a blank on ideas.

original: そうでしたのね……
traducao: I see...

original: それでしたら、以前お話されていた\nキノコ料理などはいかが？
traducao: In that case, how about that mushroom\ndish you mentioned before?

original: 滋養強壮にもなりますし、\n私、是非一度味わってみたいですわ
traducao: It's highly nutritious.\nI would very much like to try it!

original: ああ、あれかぁ！
traducao: Oh, that!

original: でも、あれを作るには\n特別かつ極上の材料がなきゃ\nダメなんだよなぁ
traducao: But to make it, I need some\nreally special, top-quality\ningredients.

original: これから一人で取りに行くってのは、\nちょっと……
traducao: Going out to gather them all by\nmyself right now is a bit...

original: 人手があればよろしいんですのね？
traducao: So you just need some extra hands?

original: わかりました。\n私が何とか掛け合ってみます
traducao: Understood.\nI will see what I can do.

original: 本当か？\nそれなら話は早え
traducao: Really?\nThat's great!

original: よーし、思い立ったが何とやらだ。\n行動あるのみだぜ！
traducao: Alright, no time like the present.\nLet's get moving!

original: クエスト「最高の一品を求めて」が\nエントリーされました。\nティトレイから受ける事が出来ます
traducao: The quest "In Search of the Best" has\nbeen added to the roster.\nYou can accept it from Tytree.

original: うーっし、みんな集まったな？
traducao: Alright, is everyone here?

original: 急に呼び付けるから\n何かと思えば……
traducao: You called so suddenly,\nI wondered what it was about...

original: ふむ。\nまあ、いい気分転換にはなるか
traducao: Hmph.\nWell, I guess it's a nice change of pace.

original: おい、ちょっと待て。\n何で俺までここに……
traducao: Hey, wait a minute.\nWhy am I here...?

original: 私が推薦したのですわ
traducao: I recommended you.

original: ナタリア？
traducao: Natalia?

original: アッシュは以前、\nお母様のご病気を治す為、\nキノコ採取に行った事があるのです
traducao: Asch, you previously went gathering\nmushrooms to cure your mother's\nillness.

original: きっと、その時の経験を活かして、\n素晴らしいキノコを\n見つけてきてくれるはずですわ
traducao: I'm sure you can use that experience\nto help find some truly\nmagnificent mushrooms.

original: ティトレイの料理は絶品ですもの。\nそのティトレイが是非にと推す一品、\n私もとても楽しみにしていますわ
traducao: Tytree's cooking is excellent.\nI am really looking forward to a dish\nthat Tytree highly recommends.
Ugh...

original: ああまで言われては、断れんな
traducao: We can't really refuse her now.

original: んじゃ、決まりだな
traducao: Then it's decided!

original: 待ってろナタリア。\n今にすげえ旨いモン食わしてやっからよ
traducao: Just you wait, Natalia.\nI'll feed you something real good!

original: 期待していますわよ、ティトレイ。\nそれに、アッシュも
traducao: I'm counting on you, Tytree.\nAnd Asch, too.

original: ここだな？\nハナアブラダケの生息地ってのは
traducao: Is this the place?\nThe habitat for Hanaaburadake.

original: ああ
traducao: Yeah.

original: あまり繁殖力の強いキノコではないから\n数を集めるのに時間はかかるかもしれんが\nここなら問題なく採取出来るだろう
traducao: Since they don't reproduce quickly,\ncollecting them may take time, but\nwe should find plenty here.

original: うおっし。\nばんばん採って、みんなに自慢の\nキノコスープを振る舞ってやるぜえ！
traducao: Alright!\nI'll gather a ton and treat everyone\nto my famous mushroom soup!

original: フン。\nそう上手くいけばいいがな……
traducao: Hmph.\nLet's hope it goes that smoothly...

original: この辺りは、\n毒性のキノコも多く生息している
traducao: This area is also home to\nmany poisonous mushrooms.

original: 怪しいと思ったら、むやみに\n手を触れるなよ
traducao: If something looks suspicious,\ndon't touch it.

original: わかってるって。\n要はハナアブラダケしか\n採らなきゃいいんだろ？
traducao: I know, I know.\nI just need to avoid picking anything\nbut Hanaaburadake, right?

original: おっ！
traducao: Oh!

original: そう言ってる間に、\n早速一つゲットだぜ！！
traducao: And just like that,\nI got one already!!

original: 馬鹿、それは\nハナアブラドクドクダケだ！
traducao: Idiot, that's a\nHanaaburadokudokudake!

original: 誤って口にしてみろ、\n一瞬であの世逝きだぞ！！
traducao: If you eat that by mistake,\nyou'll drop dead in an instant!!

original: えっ？　ほ、本当か！？
traducao: Huh? R-Really!?

original: ふむ……。\n確かにこれは、\nハナアブラドクドクダケだ
traducao: Hmmm...\nHe's right. This is indeed a\nHanaaburadokudokudake.

original: 非常に毒性が高い事で有名だが、\nハナアブラダケと類似点が多く\nなかなか見分ける事が困難なのだ
traducao: It's famous for being highly toxic,\nbut it looks so much like a\nHanaaburadake, it's hard to tell apart.

original: よく知っていたな
traducao: I'm impressed you knew that.

original: フン……。\n本で少し調べた事があるだけだ
traducao: Hmph...\nI just read about it in a book once.

original: ああ、母親の為にってやつか？
traducao: Ah, the thing for your mother?

original: アッシュってツンツンしてっけど、\n結構いいとこあんだなぁ
traducao: You act all prickly, Asch, but\nyou actually have a soft side.

original: だ、黙れ！\n口を動かす暇があったら\n手と頭を動かしやがれ！！
traducao: S-Shut up!\nIf you have time to flap your gums,\nmove your hands and use your head!!

original: ははっ。\n照れてんのか？\n何かお前、いい奴だなぁ
traducao: Haha!\nAre you embarrassed?\nYou're a good guy!

original: 嫌味が全く通じていないな……
traducao: The sarcasm didn't get through at all...

original: おい……これを見ろ！
traducao: Hey... look at this!

original: 何だ、キノコが見つかったのか？
traducao: What, did you find a mushroom?

original: って、うわっ！\nすげえ毒々しい色のキノコだな
traducao: Whoa!\nThat's one nasty-looking mushroom.

original: ニガニガグリグリダケだ。\nこの辺りでの生息は確認されて\nいなかったのだが……
traducao: It's a Niganigaguriguridake.\nI didn't think they grew in\nthis area, though...

original: どうやらどこかから胞子でも\n飛んできたらしい。\nいや、それとも新種か、亜種か？
traducao: Some spores must have blown in\nfrom elsewhere.\nWait, could it be a new subspecies?

original: そもそもこことは環境条件が\n適合しないはずだが……
traducao: The environmental conditions here\nshouldn't even be suitable for it...

original: 何だよ、\nハナアブラダケじゃないなら\nいいじゃねえか
traducao: Whatever.\nIf it's not a Hanaaburadake,\nwho cares?

original: 早く探しに行こうぜ
traducao: Let's keep looking.

original: 何を言う！　貴重なサンプルだぞ。\nこのニガニガグリグリダケを足がかりに\nこの一帯の生態系の変化が掴めるかもしれん
traducao: Nonsense! This is a rare sample!\nThis Niganigaguriguridake might help us\nunderstand local ecological changes!

original: ニガニガグリグリだか、\nイボイボブツブツだか知らねえが、\nいつまで油を売ってるつもりだ？
traducao: Niganiga whatever, Iboibo whatever,\nI don't care.\nHow long are you going to slack off?

original: おお〜、ハナアブラダケだけに\n油を売ってるって？
traducao: Ooh, slacking off like a lazy\nHanaaburadake? Nice pun!

original: はっはっはっは。\nやっぱ、アッシュって\n面白ぇ奴だよな〜！
traducao: Hahahaha!\nYou really are a funny\nguy, Asch!

original: ギャグで言ったわけじゃねえ！
traducao: I wasn't making a joke!

original: おい、二人とも手を貸せ！\n状態のいいニガニガグリグリダケを\n幾つか採取していくぞ
traducao: Hey, both of you lend a hand!\nWe're going to collect some good\nNiganigaguriguridake samples!

original: お前は人の話を聞け！！
traducao: Listen to me!!

original: しっかし、アッシュはほんとに\n毒キノコの見分け方が上手いよなぁ
traducao: Still, you're really good at spotting\npoisonous mushrooms, Asch.

original: 何かコツでもあんのか？
traducao: Do you have some kind of trick?

original: ひだの色や傘の膨らみ、\nそれに条線の有無で判別している
traducao: I check the color of the gills,\nthe shape of the cap and the striations.

original: それぞれ別のキノコである以上、\nどこかに決定的な違いがあるはずだ。\nそれを見分けているだけに過ぎん
traducao: Since they're different mushrooms,\nthere has to be a decisive difference.\nI just look for it.

original: すっげえなぁ。\nキノコのスペシャリストって感じだな
traducao: Amazing.\nYou're like a mushroom specialist.

original: いや、いっそ博士か。\nよっ、キノコ博士！
traducao: No, more like a professor.\nHey there, Professor Mushroom!

original: 妙な名前で呼ぶんじゃねえ！\n斬られたいか！！
traducao: Don't call me that!\nDo you want to get sliced!?

original: おい、みんな！　すごいぞ！！
traducao: Hey, everyone! This is amazing!!

original: すぐそこに貴重な魔物の巣を見つけた。\n卵を早速サンプルとして\n採取してみたんだが……
traducao: I found a rare monster nest nearby.\nI collected an egg as a sample,\nbut...

original: おい。\nまさか……
traducao: Hey.\nDon't tell me...

original: シッ。\n何か聞こえるぜ
traducao: Shh.\nI hear something.

original: ああ、どうやら親に勘付かれたらしい。\nこの卵だけは死守するぞ、お前達も手伝え！
traducao: The parents seem to have noticed.\nWe must protect this egg! Help me out!

original: この偏執博物学者が！\nお前の脳みそはスポンジか！？
traducao: You eccentric natural historian!\nIs your brain made of sponge!?

original: やばいって、\nマジで大群でこっち来んぞ！！
traducao: This is bad,\na whole swarm is coming right at us!!

original: うむ。\nだから早く逃げろと伝えに来たのだ。\n行くぞ
traducao: Yes.\nThat's why I came to tell you to run.\nLet's go!

original: くっ……、覚えておけ。\n後で必ず、血祭りにあげてやる……！！
traducao: Ugh... just you wait.\nI'll make you pay for this later...!!

original: 待てよ、おれを置いてくなって！
traducao: Wait, don't leave me behind!

original: よーっし、こんだけあれば十分だろ
traducao: Alright, this should be enough.

original: ふむ……。\n貴重なサンプルも手に入ったし、\nなかなか充実した時間だったな
traducao: Hmmm...\nI got some precious samples too.\nThat was quite a fulfilling time.

original: 何だよ、アッシュ。\nこれくらいで、\nへこたれちまったのか？
traducao: What's wrong, Asch?\nDid that little sprint\ntire you out?

original: ちっと、修行が足りないんじゃねえのか
traducao: You need to train more.

original: 誰のせいだと思っている！
traducao: Whose fault do you think it is!?

original: そうだぞティトレイ。\n反省しろ
traducao: He's right, Tytree.\nYou should reflect on your actions.

original: お前もだ！！
traducao: You too!!

original: さ〜て。\nこっからは、おれの本領発揮だな
traducao: Well then.\nNow it's time for me to shine.

original: 何だよアッシュ、怖い顔して。\n嬉しくねえのか？
traducao: What's with the scary look, Asch?\nAren't you happy?

original: これから先、お前達には同行しない。\n何があってもごめんだ。\n二度とな
traducao: I'm never traveling with you two again.\nNo matter what happens.\nNever again.

original: 随分な物言いだな。\n仲間同士、もう少し仲良くしたら\nどうなんだ
traducao: That's quite a thing to say.\nShouldn't comrades get along a\nlittle better?

original: 誰のせいでこうなったと思っている！！
traducao: Whose fault do you think this is!!

original: あ〜わかったわかった。\nアッシュは腹減って\nイライラしてんだろ？
traducao: Ah, I get it, I get it.\nYou're just irritable because you're\nhungry, right, Asch?

original: すぐ支度すっからよ、\n楽しみに待っててくれよな
traducao: I'll start cooking right away,\nso look forward to it!

original: そう落ち込むな。\nナタリアの喜ぶ顔が見たかったのだろう？
traducao: Don't be so down. You wanted to see\nNatalia's happy face, didn't you?

original: 黙れ、この偏執博物学者
traducao: Shut up, you eccentric scholar.

original: くっ、ナタリアの頼みでさえなければ\n誰がこんなくだらん雑用を……
traducao: Ugh, if it wasn't for Natalia's request,\nI wouldn't be doing such trivial chores.

original: まあそう言うな
traducao: Now, don't say that.

original: ○○もご苦労だったな。\n少し体を休めて、折を見てから\n食事にしようか
traducao: Good work, ○○.\nLet's rest our bodies for a bit,\nthen eat when the time is right.
